panel.rule: distinct pool locations with a location head score, interquartile band of that score within each partition, sampled seeded
panel.note: The panel was drawn seeded at three and cut to two on cost, on Matt's call: multibrot3 (maxiter 32,679) priced at 5.0 h of the 8.9 h remaining, more than the other two together. The two that remain are julia:multibrot5 (5,467) and mandelbrot (22,794). This is NOT an unbiased draw any more - the member removed is the one with the most iterations, so the panel now leans cheap on the axis a render's cost is set by.

why_not_tracked: 25.7 MB of 48-cell vectors over 27,053 renders against a 1 MiB per-file history guard. It is a finished experiment log rather than a record anything reads: what production reads is the map cut from it, which is tracked. The manifest is what the history keeps — the row count, the bytes, the sha256, the pairs and locations measured, and the panel they were measured on.
